title: V11 · Chromium CI servido end-to-end
mission: Implementá y ejecutá un runner GitHub Actions/Playwright o Chromium equivalente contra la V11 pública para cerrar el boundary de browser-network local. Verificá command DOM/estado, desktop+narrow, previews estáticos, project context, stats truthful, ausencia de iframe/live preview y fail-closed de ingress/auth. No certifiques fresh-worker wake ni authenticated transport salvo evidencia real separada.
definition_of_done: Workflow bounded navega https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/current-tree/control-v11/ con Chromium real y registra HTTP/browser observation time.
commandInputV11, commandSendV11 y commandStateV11 existen y el estado fail-closed no inventa queued=true sin durable ref.
Desktop y narrow mantienen layout usable; Projects/Spaces/Work/History/Statistics/Organism siguen siendo vistas separadas.
Preview grid usa sólo manifest/imagenes estáticas y el documento contiene cero iframe/live-preview.
Project context y stats se renderizan con estados truthy/fail-closed; console/page errors quedan registrados.
RETURN separa browser/UI PASS de AUTH_TRANSPORT y FRESH_WORKER_WAKE boundaries, con run/artifact/digest y cero promoción Current/Served/Human Accepted.
